name: Cassandra Abram
statement: I am an artist in Cedar Rapids, Iowa. I draw and paint my own characters. Tom the monkey is one of them. His friends are pigs, a donkey, and a green dinosaur. They are bright, funny, and made to make people smile. I also paint dream-like faces. They have big eyes, clocks, and stars. They are bold and strange and fun. My work is about fun, friendship, and joy. I want to share my characters with more people, and grow as an artist.
